FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: MA20での反発とリスクオンファンダメンタルズの整合性
tldr_points: Price above MA20 with bullish momentum
Risk‑on sentiment from equity highs and improving European risk backdrop supports USD/JPY upside
RSI near overbought warns of near‑term pullback, suggesting a buy‑on‑dip approach

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] UP: MA20での反発とテクノロジー株の牽引

MA20を上回る現在価格とRSI73.8はやや過熱も上昇バイアスが継続
